// diagnostic

E0972

A `System` / `Image` / `Service` record has a field it doesn't define.

What

A `System` / `Image` / `Service` record has a field it doesn't define.

Why

These records have decision-owned field sets (D-JETOS-FREEZE1, D-JPK-IMAGE1, D-JPK-SERVICE1); an unknown field is usually a typo or a value that belongs elsewhere.

Fix

remove the field, or use one of the known fields named in the error.
